title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → APVoucher
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models. For SaaS reads, map these logical columns to the equivalent Ethos resource fields; for SaaS write-back use the reverse bridge in bridge/banner-saas/.

source_tables.description: Invoice/Credit Memo Header. Vendor invoice header — vendor, invoice date, amounts, status, payment due.
Invoice/Credit Memo Detail. Invoice commodity/accounting detail (FOAPAL distribution).
Check/Disbursement Detail. Payment/check detail for paid invoices.
Vendor validation/master. Vendor codes and names.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Banner invoice document code (the AP voucher).
Vendor PIDM. Resolve visible vendor code via SPRIDEN/FTVVEND.
Vendor name via vendor PIDM. FLAG: vendors keyed by PIDM in SPRIDEN with FTVVEND attributes.
Payment/bank method. FLAG: method modeled via bank code + check vs ACH indicator.
FOAPAL account on the invoice detail line.
FOAPAL fund on the invoice detail line.
FOAPAL organization on the invoice detail line.
Derived from natural account (Banner has no native spend category; use account).
Referenced purchase order document code, if invoice is PO-based.
